{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Charcoal wool-blend coat, knee-length straight cut, #36454F, heavy wool for warmth against the frost.
High-waisted dark denim jeans, relaxed taper fit to length below the ankle, #2B3033, durable cotton twill suitable for walking on salted roads.
Chunky black leather boots, shaft reaching just above the ankle, #1A1A1A, waterproof leather with deep treads for snowy traction.
This outfit respects your reading-focused refusals by offering a cozy yet structured look perfect for a frosty autumn morning walk. The dark color palette and heavy fabrics provide essential protection against the cold without overwhelming the everyday formality of your event. Durable materials ensure you stay comfortable and confident navigating snow-covered paths while heading to your reading session."}
